speaker: Doctor
text: I am Dr. Agent. I see you are presenting with a chronic cough, weight loss, and generalized weakness. To begin our assessment, how long have you been experiencing these symptoms?

speaker: Patient
text: 68-year-old male. The patient reports having a fever, cough, weakness, night sweats, and poor appetite persisting for 6 months. He has lost 7.5 kg (16.5 lb) over this period. No history of breathlessness, nasal discharge, nasal obstruction, palpitations, chest pain, or digestive symptoms. Released from prison 9 months ago after a 2-year sentence.

speaker: Doctor
text: That is a significant weight loss accompanied by fever and night sweats; these are classic "B symptoms." Given your recent release from prison, have you had any close contacts with individuals who had tuberculosis or lung infections?

speaker: Patient
text: My main symptom is Chronic cough and fever. I also have Weight loss, Night sweats, Generalized weakness, Poor appetite.
